title: Personal Loans vs Payday Loans
excerpt: When you need to borrow money, it's crucial to understand the differences between personal loans and payday loans to make the right choice for your financial situation.

body.text: When you need to borrow money, it's crucial to understand the differences between personal loans and payday loans to make the right choice for your financial situation.

items: Lower interest rates compared to payday loans
Credit score impacts approval and rates
Short-term loans (usually due by next payday)
Single payment due at end of term
**Interest Rates:** Personal loans typically have much lower APRs
**Loan Amount:** Personal loans offer higher amounts for major expenses
**Repayment Terms:** Personal loans provide more flexibility and time
**Application Process:** Personal loans require more documentation but offer better terms
How much you need to borrow
How quickly you need the money
